reason: My doctor said my magnesium might be low, and the named lab with a report matching the batch number is more than most supplements show me. At $24.99 for one box I would try it once, since the empty-box refund means little risk.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And I still want my doctor to confirm I am actually low before I keep taking it.
would_change_my_mind: If my blood test came back normal, I would not buy. A line explaining why bisglycinate alone is enough would make me more sure.
